control_question: How can a selector create lawful, role-relevant evidence about candidates its ordinary policy would otherwise make unobservable?

metrics.formula: exploration candidates whose role-relevant evidence crosses the preregistered standard / exploration candidates with completed rich review
metrics.name: rich_review_uplift

metrics.formula: preregistered outcome difference at the same horizon, reported with uncertainty and opportunity controls
metrics.name: standard_vs_exploration_outcome_gap

metrics.formula: accommodation requests dispositioned before testing / accommodation requests received before testing
metrics.name: accommodation_pretest_resolution_rate

metrics.formula: overrides to advance and overrides to reject / decisions receiving human review
metrics.name: override_rate_by_direction

metrics.formula: eligible applicants without any role-relevant outcome / eligible applicants
metrics.name: unobservable_outcome_share

metrics.formula: only when source-addressable and consented; repeated recommendations across deployments, never inferred from one employer
metrics.name: cross_employer_repeat_classification

prohibited_inferences: Every rejected candidate was a false negative.
A rich-review pass proves the candidate would have succeeded in the job.
An exploration cohort establishes universal prevalence.
Later success creates retroactive entitlement to the original vacancy.
A group bias audit estimates individual false-negative rate.
Randomization cures unequal opportunity, measurement drift, or treatment effects by itself.

stages.name: rich_review_exploration
stages.purpose: Make some near-threshold or model-uncertain candidates observable through a paid, accessible, role-relevant simulation or structured review.
required_controls: reasoned reconciliation with the original score
stages.selection_rule: Pre-register an uncertainty band and randomly sample within it; do not hand-pick favorable exceptions after seeing identity or protected-class data.

stages.name: employment_outcome_exploration
stages.purpose: Where lawful and organizationally authorized, observe a bounded uncertain cohort under the same role, support, and outcome horizon as the standard cohort.
required_controls: no protected-class quota disguised as randomization
stages.selection_rule: Use a pre-registered bounded sample; equalize role assignment, onboarding, access to work, and performance measurement sufficiently to avoid labeling opportunity differences as person differences.
